facts.text: Name's Dodger, kid. Stick with the crew and you eat, but keep your paws off the hot dog cart.
facts.why: Dodger is the one who leads Oliver in raiding Louie's hot dog cart. He would never tell him to keep off it.
facts.fix: Name's Dodger, kid. Stick with the crew and you eat, and the hot dog cart is first on the list.

facts.text: Einstein the Great Dane pulling the cart
facts.why: Einstein is the Great Dane in Fagin's gang, but no source or search shows him pulling a cart. In the chauffeur shuffle Dodger asks him for a fender bender at two lights.
